targetTasks.summary: Current window: Test. Claim only task rg10-test-bilidili-scenario-acceptance-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG0-RG9 are accepted. Latest accepted AlembicPlugin commit is 13c52f18c3a5e5411f838277c9ccc0636b43ba7c; latest accepted AlembicCore commit is a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. Requirement authority: RG-10 final acceptance requires a real BiliDili Swift project test-mode chain, not full cold start, not mock-only evidence. Read Test/AGENTS.md, parent AGENTS.md, active index/status, this state root, Test/docs/testing-operation-policy.md, Test/docs/current/test-window-alignment.md, and Test/skills/alembic-real-routes/SKILL.md before executing. Goal: collect controller-reviewable evidence for the BiliDili test-mode four-step chain and classify the final demand as pass/rework/blocked/inconclusive. Test object: /Users/gaoxuefeng/Documents/AlembicWorkspace/BiliDili, a real Swift app. Use test mode with scoped subset dimensions and small budgets; do not run a full cold-start/fullReset. Required evidence chain: (1) Planning truthfulness: run or probe alembic_plan draft for BiliDili and show selected/recommended dimensions and scale are grounded in real project signals, including Swift/SwiftUI/UI/networking/concurrency or comparable BiliDili facts, not a language-only guess. Confirm a small subset such as architecture, swift-objc-idiom, and ui-interaction, or justify a different subset with evidence. (2) Scoped generation: after a confirmed Plan, run test-mode scoped generation/module-mining for selected dimensions/module scope; prove it creates Recipe/knowledge output anchored to ProjectContext, writes source_refs/region vector state where available, and is immediately retrievable through prime/search or equivalent MCP/API output. (3) Commit-driven evolution: in BiliDili, record git HEAD/status, create a controlled reversible test branch or isolated commit sequence with all three changes: rename one .swift file, modify one logic path, and add a small new Package/module area. Trigger the relevant Alembic Plugin tool call(s) so commit-driven unified evolution observes HEAD changes. Prove classification/routing: high-confidence rename repairs source_refs automatically, logic change creates or updates an evolution proposal, new module produces module-mining/scoped-scan recommendation or signal, Plan projection reflects current state, and lifecycle/proposal/source_ref records are present. Clean up or leave a clearly named test branch/commit with restoration instructions; do not silently dirty the user's branch. (4) Vector degradation: stop or disable the local Ollama/vector provider only through a safe, reversible Test-authorized route; if stopping Ollama would disrupt unrelated user work or requires permission unavailable in this window, return blocked with exact evidence. Then prove vector availability reports isAvailable=false or equivalent unavailable/degraded status and tool output exposes observable degradation rather than silent success. Additional checks: verify Plugin/Core local source linkage or record exact runtime source if the route uses installed artifacts; run the smallest relevant Plugin/Core build/check or cite fresh controller evidence when rerunning would not add value; record BiliDili git status before/after, dashboard/API URLs/logs/job ids/session ids, commands, JSON outputs, and report paths. Boundaries: Test does not implement product fixes, does not edit AlembicPlugin/Core product source, does not start Alembic main follow-on implementation, does not perform broad Recipe quality evaluation, does not full cold-start BiliDili, does not delete evidence/proposals/vector structures, and does not repair current Codex MCP by destructive reload unless explicitly required and separately authorized. If any step cannot be run safely or evidence is missing, return blocked or inconclusive with the first blocker and smallest repair/redispatch recommendation. Success means all four BiliDili test-mode steps have raw evidence and no in-scope blocker. Failure means product behavior is connected but violates one of the four acceptance facts, with the owning repository repair recommendation. Invalid conclusions: do not claim full-scale Recipe quality, Alembic main portability follow-on, or current Codex host-session MCP reload correctness from this RG-10 test.
